name: diagram-design
description: Editorial diagram design for Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot, Factory Droid, and Pi. 44 diagram types. Self-contained HTML + SVG. No shadows. No Mermaid slop.
one_liner: Teaches AI coding assistants how to draw clean, professional-looking diagrams instead of the generic boxy charts most tools produce.
buyer: A technical writer or dev-tools company that publishes documentation and wants diagrams that look designed, not auto-generated, without hiring a designer for every chart.
business_use_cases: A startup's docs team uses it to produce polished architecture diagrams for its developer documentation site.
A consultant preparing technical pitch decks uses it to generate clean quadrant and sequence diagrams on the fly.
An agency onboarding client brand colors uses it to auto-style every diagram it produces for that client's docs.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a documentation-polish service for dev-tool startups: redo their existing diagrams in this editorial style.
Sell custom brand/theme packs so agencies can match client styling automatically.

steal_this: This weekend, offer to re-draw a dev-tool company's docs diagrams in this style as a paid one-off and use the before/after as your own portfolio piece.
